chemistry.notes: Estimated: 2018-2019 30 kWh pack (200 cells): no page names its chemistry; the 2015-2017 192-cell pack is nickel-rich NCM (Kia claims) and the 2018 update added cells to the same pack design. Same cell family assumed.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: no page describes battery warming on the Soul EV; Kia's first battery conditioning arrived with the 2022-2023 EV6 (software update, InsideEVs), years after this car.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: no page found states the Soul EV onboard charger kW (Mobility Engineering Tech lists only J1772 L1/L2); fueleconomy.gov: about 4 hours at 240 V for the 27 kWh car implies roughly 6.7 kW. Inference, not an allowed basis: verify. Applied to 2015-2019 (same CHAdeMO-era charger; pack grew in 2018 but no charger change found).

dc_max_kw.notes: Fastned network data (method not stated): max charge speed 50 kW CHAdeMO (European 2017-2019 listing, labelled 33 kWh: not the 27/30 kWh North American pack; years 2015-2016 not covered). Conflicts: Electrek says earlier CHAdeMO models topped out around 70 kW; Wikipedia says up to 100 kW.
